create_discounting_chain_environment: create a DiscountingChain environment instance with an optional mapping_seed to control which chain has the bonus reward
reset_discounting_chain: reset the DiscountingChain environment to start a new episode with timestep zero and context negative one
step_discounting_chain: step the DiscountingChain environment with an action to advance the chain and receive rewards at designated timesteps
get_observation_spec: get the observation specification returning a float32 array with shape one by two for context and time to live
get_optimal_return: get the optimal return property of DiscountingChain which returns the maximum achievable reward of one point one
